customer_question: One RF test item didn't pass, but it was only in the Test Plan as a precaution because we weren't sure if the DUT supports Enhanced Power Control. How should this item be handled?
question_variants: Is a non-pass on an optional-feature test item a real failure if the DUT reports it doesn't support that feature?
Should we exclude this RF test item from the report since the DUT's own response says it's unsupported?
Do we need to redo this test, or just remove it from scope?
actual_issue: An RF test item (RF/TRM/CA) was included in the Test Plan only as a precaution, since it was unclear whether the DUT supported the optional Enhanced Power Control feature. The test did not pass, and it needed to be determined whether this represented a genuine compliance failure or simply confirmation that the feature is unsupported and the item should be excluded from scope.
plain_english_explanation: Some Bluetooth tests only apply if a device claims to support a particular optional feature. Here, nobody was sure in advance whether the device supported one such feature, so the test was run just in case. The device's own response during the test made it clear it doesn't support that feature, so the test item doesn't apply and shouldn't be counted as a failure -- it should simply be left out of the final report.
consultant_answer: The RF/TRM/CA test log explicitly shows the DUT responding with a non-support indication for Enhanced Power Control. Since the DUT itself confirms it does not support this optional feature, the test item should be treated as out of scope: exclude it from the applicable test items, remove it from the test log, and prepare the RF report on that basis. The Test Plan should also be updated to reflect that this item is excluded going forward.
decision_logic: A test item that was only included in the Test Plan due to uncertainty about optional feature support should be excluded from scope, not treated as a failure, once the DUT's own protocol-level response in that test's log explicitly confirms non-support for the feature in question.
final_recommendation: Exclude the Enhanced Power Control RF test item from the applicable test items, remove it from the test log, update the Test Plan to reflect the exclusion, and finalize the RF report without counting this item as a failure.
risk_if_done_wrong: Counting this item as a failed test result instead of excluding it as out of scope would incorrectly flag the DUT as non-compliant on a feature it was never required to support, requiring rework of the Test Plan, log, and RF report to correct.
